external_entities.name: colleagues
external_entities.description: Colleagues who sign in through the identity broker and use applications.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are, including their own devices at home.

external_entities.name: franchise colleagues
external_entities.description: Colleagues from franchise stores who authenticate through their own identity provider.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them

external_entities.name: HR system
external_entities.description: The system that supplies group membership changes and leaver information overnight.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Group membership is not maintained there by hand — it comes from the HR system overnight.

external_entities.name: franchise identity provider
external_entities.description: The identity provider operated by a franchise that vouches for franchise colleagues.
external_entities.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them
external_entities.notes: It is not written down which colleagues this provider is allowed to vouch for.

processes.name: identity broker
processes.description: Signs colleagues in, issues tokens, validates federated sign-in, signs tokens, and supplies public signing material to applications.
processes.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.

processes.name: store admin console
processes.description: An application that uses token groups to authorize price changes and transaction voids across stores.
processes.source_excerpt: The store admin console is one of those applications.

data_stores.name: key store
data_stores.description: A store containing the signing key used by the identity broker for tokens.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.
data_stores.notes: The text does not state whether the key store is encrypted where it sits.

data_stores.name: directory
data_stores.description: The identity broker's directory of colleagues and their group memberships.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.
data_stores.notes: The text does not state whether the directory is encrypted where it sits.

data_stores.name: audit log
data_stores.description: A log to which the broker writes sign-ins.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_stores.notes: Nobody has written down what the log records or whether it covers the franchise route. The text does not state whether the log is encrypted where it sits.

data_flows.name: sign-in
data_flows.description: Colleagues sign in to the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are

data_flows.name: issue token
data_flows.description: The identity broker issues a token to a signed-in colleague.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Once the broker has signed a colleague in it issues them a token.
data_flows.notes: The token carries the colleague's staff id and a list of the groups they are in.
data_flows.data_description: Token containing staff id and group membership

data_flows.name: present token
data_flows.description: A colleague presents a token when using the store admin console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every application takes that token and decides what the colleague may do from the groups in it.

data_flows.name: fetch public half
data_flows.description: The store admin console fetches the public half of the token-signing key from the broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Applications fetch the public half from the broker to check the signature.
data_flows.data_description: Public half of the signing key

data_flows.name: sync membership
data_flows.description: The HR system supplies group membership and leaver changes to the identity broker overnight.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker pulls the changes once a night

data_flows.name: vouch sign-in
data_flows.description: The franchise identity provider vouches for a franchise colleague's sign-in to the broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in
data_flows.notes: It is not written down which colleagues that provider is allowed to vouch for.
data_flows.data_description: Federated sign-in assertion about a franchise colleague

data_flows.name: keep signing key
data_flows.description: The identity broker keeps its token-signing key in the key store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_flows.name: keep membership
data_flows.description: The identity broker keeps colleagues and group membership in its directory.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.

data_flows.name: write sign-ins
data_flows.description: The identity broker writes sign-in events to the audit log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_flows.notes: The text does not say what the log records or whether it covers the franchise route.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network where the identity broker and store admin console run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The broker runs on the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: colleagues' own devices at home
trust_boundaries.description: Devices used by colleagues to sign in from home and controlled by the colleagues rather than the organisation.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: including their own devices at home

trust_boundaries.name: franchise stores
trust_boundaries.description: The franchise environment from which franchise colleagues are admitted to the system.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: We also let the franchise stores in.

assumptions.assumption: The directory's data is confidential because it contains colleagues and their group memberships.
assumptions.basis: The directory contains colleagues and the groups they are in.

assumptions.assumption: The signing key in the key store is confidential because it is a token-signing key.
assumptions.basis: The key store contains the signing key used to sign tokens.
